name: Imparagon
source:
Solve puzzles to become the best and sexiest of the The Mistress's minions! Over 50+ Transformations to discover! 

Come and join a lovely bunch of Imps as they attempt to navigate their way through a week of magical chaos! their goal is to emerge on the other side having improved themselves enough to claim the affections of their beloved Mistress. 

[From [url=https://slushyanimals.itch.io/imparagon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
解開謎題，成為女主人手下最棒、最性感的隨從！超過五十種變身形態等你發現！

來和一群可愛的小惡魔一起，設法闖過魔法亂子不斷的一星期吧！它們希望一週結束時，自己已經變得足夠出色，能贏得心愛的女主人的寵愛。

［摘自[url=https://slushyanimals.itch.io/imparagon]Itch.io[/url]］
